title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance: Request Channels, Service Reach and Repeat Calls
content:
## The basis the dispatch desk applies

Assistance under a Keyturn Roadside Assistance plan is dispatched only through the channels the plan
allows, and a request made through a channel the plan does not carry is taken but dispatched under the
plan's ordinary terms rather than its response target.

A vehicle outside the plan's service radius is still attended where an operator can reach it, and the
miles beyond the radius are charged at the plan's out-of-radius rate. The rate falls on the number of
miles by which the vehicle stands beyond the radius.

A second call for the same fault inside the plan's duplicate window is the same callout and consumes no
further credit, however many times the member calls.

### The three clauses as condition and result

| Condition | Result |
| --- | --- |
| The request comes through a channel the plan allows | Assistance is dispatched, and the plan's response target governs |
| The request comes through a channel the plan does not carry | The request is taken; assistance is dispatched under the plan's ordinary terms, the plan's response target not governing |
| The vehicle stands beyond the plan's service radius and an operator can reach it | The vehicle is attended, and the plan's out-of-radius rate is applied to the miles beyond the radius |
| A further call is made for the same fault inside the plan's duplicate window | It is the same callout; no further credit is consumed, however many calls are made |

### A worked illustration of the out-of-radius basis

Take, purely as an illustration and not as any plan's figures, a plan whose service radius stands at 40
miles and whose out-of-radius rate stands at USD 4.00 for each mile beyond it, and a vehicle standing
58 miles from the member's home city that an operator can reach. The vehicle is attended. It stands 18
miles beyond the radius, so the rate is applied to those 18 miles and comes to USD 72.00; the miles
within the radius are not what the rate is applied to.
